items.title: John Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 18, 2023 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: They would find Cole Porter, I’ve got a whole thing over here... We had the Real Book... I learned from Bucky Pizzarelli

ctx.x: Along those lines, if there was such a thing as a jazz police and they came to your house with a search warrant, would they find any Real Books in your house?

No. You know what they would find? They would find Cole Porter, I’ve got a whole thing over here, there’s Johnny Mercer, Sammy Cahn, Jerome Kern. We had the Real Book, the old school Real Book. Bucky had it in a binder. He used to — I think it was either me or him would say what you should do is you start at the beginning — it’s usually “Alone Together” is the first one, you know A. Or “A Child is Born.” You learn the first one and you rip it out. You learn it. You learn the next one, you rip it out. And at the…
